//: Values that are random or a measurement, so two runs never agree on them (04 §2, point 5). They are compared by shape, not by value. Every entry needs a reason, and one is added only when a Node-against-Node replay shows the value differs. This is not the place for a Java difference: those go in allowed-diffs.json, with an approval.

csrfToken.reason: Random CSRF token, echoed in the X-CSRF-Token header

correlationId.reason: Random per-request id in error bodies

GET /api/health.reason: Reports this process's own memory and uptime; answers 503 when its heap is over the threshold

GET /api/admin/system/health.reason: Reports this process's own memory and uptime

POST /api/admin/lots/draw.reason: The draw is random (crypto.randomInt). Checked: same teams and athletes, lots 1..N. Then the replay's stored order is set to the recorded one, so later requests see the same running order

password.reason: bcrypt hash with a random salt. Both sides must store a cost-12 bcrypt hash

tokenHash.reason: SHA-256 of a random refresh token

family.reason: Random UUID naming a refresh-token family
